question: KMLM switcher + VIX sleeve 75/25: what capping or vol-scaling the 75% leveraged leg costs in CAGR per point of max DD saved, on the engine's own path

inputs.cost_source: cost_fit.json (Composer-equivalent, add. 38), applied to each variant's own turnover

cap37.5_1x.label: cap 37.5%, released half in the 1x twin

two_x.label: 2x substitution (USD, SSO; 2/3 of TECL, LABU, SQQQ)

one_x.label: 1x reference (XLK, SMH, SPY, XBI, PSQ, VIXY)

soxl_dip_ft.label: by-product: SOXL dip-buy branch removed (the edited tree falls through to its next checks)

close.note: the edited tree's holding into 11-05 (SOXL 37.5 / TECL 37.5, the engine's own close decision under both trees); at the 16:00 closes only

worst_of_branches_placebo.note: the SOXL dip-buy is the minimum of the branch t-stats; a placebo percentile this low for the worst of n branches is expected 1 - (1 - p)^n of the time

edge.note: leg return = the leveraged holdings' return at their base weights / 0.75 (the leg at 100%); sigma = the holdings' weighted realized 20-session vol at the prior close; VIX = prior close; in sample on the engine's own path; mirror = the same names' 1x twins (XLK, SMH, SPY, XBI, PSQ, VIXY; SVIX itself) on the same days with the same vol labels

fallthrough.edit: the live tree with its RSI10(SOXL) < 30 condition disabled (rhs -1): that if falls through to its else-branch (SPXL RSI10 < 30, LABU RSI10 < 25, the XLK-vs-KMLM switcher)

gate.simulator: replay.SimW (Wilder RSI), the engine's own, same panel and sessions

fallthrough.basis: symphony-level: the 75% group's contribution to the session (SOXL 75% as built vs the fall-through holdings vs 75% in PULS), before costs; synthetic / real split at SOXL's launch 2010-03-11

concentration.note: every since-2015 ratio divides by the Feb-Mar 2020 drawdown; a full-window ratio that divides by < 3 pp of DD saved is ill-conditioned

honesty: All variants are in-sample re-sizings of a live rule on its own reconstructed path: the KMLM rules were built on 2015-26, and every variant is a function of the same holdings; the 1995-2015 years are out of sample for the rules but synthetic for most legs.

Synthetic data before each fund's launch (long_panel, ts_synth VIX mode): SOXL real from 2010-03-11, TECL 2008-12-30, SPXL 2008-11-05, LABU 2015-05-28, SQQQ 2010-02-11, UVXY 2011-10-04, SVIX 2022-03-30, VXZ 2018-01-25, ZVOL 2023-04-19; PULS = BIL on the whole path, 2018-26 included (long_panel sets PULS to BIL; BIL real from 2007-05-30, T-bills before), so released weight earns T-bills throughout; the KMLM signal from RYMFX before 2020-12-02 and a trend proxy before 2007-02-22; VIX funds before 2006 model a market that did not exist.

The 2015-26 ratios are one episode: the as-built max DD since 2015, every ratio's starting point, is 2020-01-24 → 2020-03-20 (COVID), as is every cap's; the 9 vol-target and VIX variants cut COVID below their own 2015-16 or 2018-Q4 drawdowns. So "pp of CAGR per pp of DD saved" since 2015 is priced on Feb-Mar 2020 alone. Leave-one-year-out (that year set flat for base and variant): cap 37.5 4.43 as is, 2.94 (no 2022) .. 5.55 (no 2020); vol-target k 0.43 3.35 as is, 1.99 (no 2022) .. 7.79 (no 2020); VIX > 30 0.99 as is, 0.09 (no 2022) .. 9.03 (no 2020). "VIX gates are the cheapest DD since 2015" and "vol-targeting beats caps since 2015" are statements about Feb-Mar 2020: without 2020 the vol-target costs more per pp than the cap at the same mean leg weight (7.79 vs cap 60 6.35). The full-window vol-target and VIX ratios divide by < 3 pp of DD saved (1.9 and 2.5 pp) and are ill-conditioned (vt k 0.43: 16.32 as is, 6.42 (no 2011) .. 137.67 (no 2012)). 2022 (+1,112%) is 20% of the 2015-26 log growth.

Costs: the engine's own Composer-equivalent assumption only (5.856 bps per unit of sum|dw|, i.e. 11.7 bps per full switch, add. 38), charged on each variant's own turnover; the vol-target's daily resizing pays it every day. No financing, borrow or tax beyond what the funds' (synthetic) returns embed.

Not modeled: Composer's 10pp threshold corridor (the path rebalances to target daily; live KMLM trades only when a holding drifts 10pp off target), taxes, the sleeve's own rebalancing and its interaction with a smaller leg (the sleeve stays at its path weights; released weight sits in PULS beside it). Cap 37.5 → 1x keeps the SVIX halves in SVIX (no twin), so its mean leg weight is 35.9%, not the cap's 29.8%.

2x and 1x legs are substitutions on the same decisions: the decisions (RSI thresholds on the 3x funds) are unchanged, only the instrument earning the day changes; ROM, QID and a 2x biotech fund are proxied as 2/3 of the 3x fund's daily return.

The 2026-11-05 session is outside the path (which ends at the 11-04 close): it is the live holding (SOXL 75%, PULS 16%, VXZ 9%) priced at Composer's ~15:50 prints (SOXL 44.50 per the brief; the 15:50 bar printed 44.03) and at the 16:00 closes (SOXL 40.87 after a 7% slide in the final five minutes). Composer's realized session was -26.7% (its own fills, then TECL into the close). The engine's closing-price decision on 11-04 was SOXL 37.5 / TECL 37.5; Composer held SOXL 75.5 (a knife-edge at 15:5x prices, shadow ledger): the day is shown on the live holding, as the question asks.

Vol-target and VIX rules read the decision close (d0) and earn d1, as the engine does; Composer decides at ~15:50, not the close. The matched k is solved on the full path, so the 2015-26 mean leg weight differs slightly from the cap's.

The by-product row is the real counterfactual for the SOXL dip-buy branch: the live tree with its RSI10(SOXL) < 30 condition disabled, replayed by the engine's own simulator (Wilder RSI) on the same panel; identical holdings on every one of the 7,682 non-branch sessions (checked), the fall-through holdings on the 212 branch sessions (TLT 80, SQQQ 67, dip-buy SPXL 33, pair SOXL+TECL 13, dip-buy LABU 11, pair SOXL+SVIX 8: SOXL 37.5 in a pair on only 10%), costed on its own turnover. The branch's sessions are 63% synthetic. Its 11-05 is at the 16:00 closes only: the edited tree holds the engine's own close decision (SOXL 37.5 / TECL 37.5, the same under both trees) and no ~15:50 TECL print is on file; the as-built figure is Composer's knife-edge at 15:5x prices.
